title: The Ferry Without a Pilot
premise_public: A small passenger ferry arrived on schedule. Nobody was at its steering wheel, yet the passengers were calm and the crossing was routine.
solution_summary: The ferry was remotely operated from a shore station. Its trained operator did not need to be aboard.

facts.text: The ferry supported control from another location.
An operator managed it from a shore station.
No onboard pilot was needed on this journey.
There was no emergency or hijacking.

acceptable_solutions: A remote operator steered the ferry from shore.
The boat was controlled remotely without an onboard pilot.
Someone at a shore station was operating the ferry.
hints: The person responsible for steering did not have to be visible.
Could someone operate a vehicle from somewhere else?
